Data Monitoring

Data Change Monitoring System

This system provides automated tracking of data modifications by: 1. Monitoring data file operations 2. Detecting and reporting changes 3. Maintaining state history 4. Generating technical documentation

Key Features: - Automated change detection - State persistence - Distributed tracking capability - Comprehensive documentation

Usage Example:

```python import pandas as pd

# Data operations are automatically monitored df = pd.read_csv(‘data.csv’)

# Changes are detected and reported automatically df = pd.read_csv(‘data.csv’) # Generates change report if modified ```

Version: 1.0.0

monitor.monitor_csv_operations(filepath, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Enhanced CSV reader with change detection.

Workflow: 1. Execute CSV read operation 2. Generate data summary 3. Compare with previous state 4. Update state history 5. Distribute state information

Parameters:

  • filepath (str) – Path to CSV file

  • *args – Positional arguments for pd.read_csv

  • **kwargs – Keyword arguments for pd.read_csv

Returns:

Loaded data

Return type:

pd.DataFrame

monitor.run_demonstration()[source]

Execute system demonstration.

Demonstrates: 1. Initial data state 2. Change detection 3. State tracking 4. Documentation generation

The monitor module provides functionality for tracking data file operations:

  • Automatic monitoring of pandas operations

  • Change detection

  • State tracking

Example Usage

import pandas as pd

# The monitor module automatically hooks into pandas
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')  # Changes are tracked automatically
